description: The screenshot shows a split-screen desktop with DBeaver database IDE on the left side, displaying SQL query tabs and an open SQL editor with multiple queries including SELECT statements referencing table columns like "table_size", "table_name", and filtering conditions. On the right side, a Chrome browser window is open showing what appears to be a Microsoft Azure portal or cloud management interface with a dark theme, featuring a loading spinner in the center indicating the page is in a loading/waiting state. A dropdown menu or dialog is visible in the upper portion of the browser showing options including what appears to be date-related selections ("Select an item • January 2020") and numbered list items. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing various pinned applications including File Explorer, Chrome, and other system icons.

The screen shows a split workspace with DBeaver database client on the left displaying a SQL query editor with a query selecting `s_table_name` from tables with a left join, along with visible database schema/table list in the explorer panel. On the right side is a Claude AI chat interface in a web browser (visible URL contains "claude.ai"), showing a conversation with the AI where the user appears to be asking a "Quick question (so I don't mix-step it)" about something related to database administration. The system tray shows the date as January 2026 with standard Windows taskbar icons visible at the bottom.

The screen shows a split view with Visual Studio Code (VS Code) on the left displaying SQL code that includes queries with `FROM views v LEFT JOIN source_views s` and various table operations including `UNNEST(table_name)`. On the right side is a web browser (likely Chrome) showing what appears to be a Claude AI chat interface or similar dark-themed web application, with a conversation visible including text about "Quick question (as I don't see your full...)" and various other chat messages. The user appears to be working on database/SQL development while simultaneously consulting an AI assistant, with the VS Code editor showing line numbers in the 30-40 range and syntax highlighting for SQL keywords like `FROM`, `LEFT`, `JOIN`, `UNNEST`, and `WHERE`.

The screen shows a split view with three main applications: on the left is Visual Studio Code with a SQL file open containing a query with SELECT statements, JOIN operations on tables (table_time, table_value), and a WHERE clause filtering by table_name matching a pattern 'ww1_125_fin%'. In the center is a web browser (likely Edge) showing what appears to be a ChatGPT or similar AI interface with a conversation visible, including a dark-themed chat panel on the left listing previous conversations and a main chat area. On the right side is another dark-themed panel showing "Today's banking business day (India)" information dated Wednesday 15 January 2025, with text about banking holidays and a note about "Are banks closed today 24 Jan 2025?" The Windows 11 taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 6:12 PM, with various pinned applications including File Explorer, browser, and terminal icons.

The screen shows a Windows desktop with multiple applications open: on the left is VSCode (or similar IDE) displaying SQL code with a query selecting table_size, table_rows, and table_name from all_tables, with syntax highlighting in green, yellow, and white text on a dark background. On the right side is Microsoft Edge browser showing Microsoft Copilot chat interface with a dark theme, where the user appears to have asked "which business day is today? The banking" and received a response about "Today's banking business day (India)" explaining banking days and holidays. At the bottom is the Windows 11 taskbar with the start button, search, file explorer, Edge, and other pinned apps visible, showing the time as 15:02 AM.
